§4.2 C2: reserveCustomer and saveTransaction on Rpc are ExchangeTransact, TELLER only; EXECUTIVE is refused (§03 B03)

§4.2 C4: branches and employees are BranchesManage / UsersManage, ADMIN; ADMIN (ex-SYSTEM) is allowed, the owner keeps them through ADMIN (§03 A04/A05)
§4.2 C5: payment settings are SystemSettings, EXECUTIVE and ADMIN; ADMIN (ex-SYSTEM) is allowed (§02 ADMIN "ตั้งค่าระบบ")
§4.2 C7: B1 merges BACKEND and MANAGER into BRANCH_MANAGER, so ex-MANAGER gains process, retry, drawerObservation and printerOnline
